# 357. Count Numbers with Unique Digits

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def countNumbersWithUniqueDigits(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        if n == 0:
            return 1
        ans, cur = 10, 9
        for i in range(n - 1):
            cur *= (9 - i)
            ans += cur
        return ans
```
